title: Waste disposal fees for large producers under EPR for packaging - GOV.UK

triage.reason: Newly published GOV.UK guidance (2026-10-28) sets out how large producers' packaging waste disposal fees under UK pEPR are calculated, modulated by recyclability from 2026 data, paid, and enforced.

draft.summary: GOV.UK published guidance on waste disposal fees for large producers under EPR for packaging on 28 October 2026. The guidance sets out how packaging waste disposal fees are calculated, when and how to pay them, and what to do if a producer thinks a fee is wrong.
draft.source_quote: Find out how packaging waste disposal fees are calculated, when and how to pay them, and what to do if you think your fee is wrong.

key_dates.text: Start of the assessment year for which PackUK published illustrative fees in December 2025; the assessment year runs from 1 April to 31 March.

draft.interpretation: Because fees for 2026 data onwards are modulated by recyclability, producers reporting red-rated packaging face a higher per-tonne fee than those reporting green-rated packaging. That gives brand owners and converters a direct cost signal to shift specifications towards formats rated more recyclable under the recyclability assessment methodology.
